items.example: I want to get into shape before summer.
items.simple: You do sport and eat well so your body gets strong.

items.example: He's in really good shape for his age.
items.simple: Your body is strong and healthy.

items.example: I'm trying to cut back on sugar.
items.simple: You eat or do a little less of something.

items.example: I've cut out fizzy drinks completely.
items.simple: You stop eating or drinking something for good.

items.example: Too much overtime led to burnout.
items.exampleTr: Çok fazla mesai tükenmişliğe yol açtı.
items.simple: You feel tired and empty because you worked too much.

items.example: If you don't rest, you'll burn out.
items.simple: You work so hard that you have no energy left.

items.example: I'm so sleep deprived after the exams.
items.simple: You did not sleep enough, so you feel very tired.

items.example: I never get enough sleep during the week.
items.simple: Your body rests for as long as it needs at night.

items.example: I've been really stressed out at work.
items.simple: Your head feels full of worry and you cannot relax.

items.example: I don't have the stamina to run that far.
items.exampleTr: O kadar uzun koşacak dayanıklılığım yok.
items.simple: The power to keep going for a long time without stopping.

items.example: I read a book to wind down before bed.
items.exampleTr: Yatmadan önce gevşemek için kitap okurum.
items.simple: You slow down and feel calm after a busy day.

items.example: I think I'm run down. I need a few days off.
items.exampleTr: Sanırım bitkinim. Birkaç gün izne ihtiyacım var.
items.simple: Your body is tired and a little ill.

items.example: I think I'm coming down with a cold.
items.simple: You start to feel ill, like you are getting a bad cold.

items.example: A balanced diet gives you more energy.
items.exampleTr: Dengeli beslenme sana daha çok enerji verir.
items.simple: You eat many kinds of food, not too much of one thing.

items.example: I eat too much junk food at uni.
items.exampleTr: Üniversitede çok fazla abur cubur yiyorum.
items.simple: Food that tastes nice but is not good for your body.

items.example: No cake for me, thanks. I'm trying to be good.
items.exampleTr: Bana pasta yok, sağ ol. Kendimi tutmaya çalışıyorum.
items.simple: You are choosing healthy things and saying no to treats.

items.en: I used to … but now I …
items.example: I used to smoke, but now I run every morning.
items.exampleTr: Eskiden sigara içerdim ama şimdi her sabah koşuyorum.
items.simple: You tell how your old habit is different from your new one.

items.example: I want to lose a bit of weight.
items.simple: Your body gets lighter, so you weigh less.

items.example: I've put on weight since the winter.
items.simple: Your body gets heavier because you eat a lot.

items.example: He lifts weights to build muscle.
items.simple: Your arms and legs get bigger and stronger.

items.example: I often skip breakfast when I'm late.
items.exampleTr: Geç kaldığımda sık sık kahvaltıyı atlarım.
items.simple: You do not eat in the morning.

items.example: Go home and rest up for a few days.
items.exampleTr: Eve git, birkaç gün dinlenip toparlan.
items.simple: You rest a lot so you get well or strong again.

items.example: He gave up smoking two years ago.
items.simple: You do not smoke any more.
